scenario.title: Hosting ownership and existing delivery providers
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: No live external-provider adoption performed; confirm which existing non-Actions deployment systems have a supported integration rather than inferring one.
Confirm the project-specific rollback and incident runbook before treating a mapped pipeline as operationally ready.

lessons.title: Preserve the existing pipeline
lessons.when: Survey finds deployed app or CI/release files
lessons.need: Map the existing app and installed Pack receipts. Existing scripts are evidence to inspect, not permission to reinstall infrastructure. Current executor can dispatch a project-owned GitHub Actions workflow.
lessons.surface: Onboard profile lines 9–42; flow runner contract lines 287–312.
lessons.gap: Onboarding offers no-host projects only merge-only/no-default although the executor supports external-project Actions delivery. Proposed adoption branch needs to separate infrastructure ownership from delivery orchestration.

lessons.title: Know which Pack fits
lessons.when: Agent proposes new hosting or an infrastructure/deploy Pack
lessons.need: Shipped hosting path targets AWS. Production Deploy assumes VPS/Compose/CloudFront; preview templates assume FastAPI/Next.js on a Docker host. Preview actual dependencies, prerequisites and resources before approval.
lessons.surface: Onboard profile lines 24–35 and domain-and-deploy lines 36–54; installed Pack README owns adaptation.
lessons.gap: Public adoption guidance needs these support limits before the user accepts a Pack. Do not present provider prose as an executable adapter.

lessons.title: Keep test CI separate from deploy CI
lessons.need: Only a declared eligible Actions test workflow uses command-ci. Deploy/release/build workflows are not that declaration; other CI keeps the documented native-command path.
lessons.gap: Existing-provider discovery should name this distinction before auto-binding tests or offering a merge queue.
